evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern raised — customer was ready to book from the start; full credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'This is only an estimate... if it only takes about the two and a half hour then you will only be charged for the [minimum]' — matches the 'pay less if beats it' line.

top_strength: Warm, efficient close for a customer who called in ready to book — confirmed all details cleanly and set a friendly tone ('thank you for choosing Einstein... we'll see you tomorrow').
coaching_note: No explicit close or rate-lock language was actually spoken by the rep — the booking happened because the customer asked for it, not because the rep asked; worth practicing the explicit ask even when the customer leads.
judgment_calls: stage3_close scored 0 despite the booking succeeding — the customer initiated the booking ask, so neither a rate-lock line nor an explicit 'would you like our help' ask was ever said by the rep; scored what was said, not the outcome.
